_README: Platform-level recruit adapters config. One company = one line. Keys: beisen=<tenant> zhiye.com slug; moka=<org>/<siteId> (derived campus URL) or an object with explicit sites. Value is the canonical company name (string shorthand) or an object {name, host?, ignore_categories?, categories?, sites?}. Adding a line registers the company in qiuzhao.collector.p1_pipeline.REGISTRY via the platform module. Keys: feishu=<portal object> (config-driven Feishu jobs portal). Keys: workday=<tenant>/<region>/<site> (CXS); successfactors=<career-site host>; dayee=<SU hash> (Dayee hotjob.cn, value {name, host}). Workday value may be an object {name, search_text (string|{scope:str}), max_list_pages, campus_keywords, intern_keywords}; SuccessFactors value may be {name, query, country, page_size, max_list_pages, campus_keywords, intern_keywords}. Keys: avature=<host>/<locale>/<portal> (Avature search portal; optional search, offset_param, page_size_param); icims=<portal host> (iCIMS Career Portal; the adapter refuses hosts whose robots.txt disallows crawling); orc=<host>/<siteNumber> (Oracle Recruiting Cloud candidate experience).

tupu360._README: tupu360 (图谱天下) multi-tenant recruitment sites. Key = tenant slug on careersite.tupu360.com (override with "tenant"). Value {name, host?, tenant?, channels?, extra_channels?, scope?, wechat_only?, url?, enabled?, enabled_reason?, note?, blocked_reason?}. Careersite tenants are public/server-rendered; wxtemp tenants (<slug>.tupu360.com) only answer behind WeChat OAuth. ROBOTS: tupu360's robots.txt is a platform-wide "User-agent: * / Disallow: /". 站长决定 2026-09-20（原话“接回来的60家都开”）：the 60 careersite tenants that the 2026-09-19 full-site run read anonymously (180 tenant x scope units, 5523 real postings) ship enabled:true with that decision recorded per row in enabled_reason; the platform robots.txt above was known and accepted by 站长. STILL DISABLED (8 rows, blocked_reason): 7 WeChat-only wxtemp tenants (nestle, taitaile, autoliv, louisvuitton, jntl, google, boschhuayu-steering) whose anonymous side has no public route, plus johnsonelectric whose official careersite tenant publishes 0 postings on every public channel -- enabling those would only add guaranteed-empty units, so they stay parked. TO ENABLE/DISABLE ONE COMPANY: flip its own "enabled" (and move the reason between enabled_reason/blocked_reason); nothing else is needed -- the adapter re-reads this file at import, p1_pipeline merges the section into REGISTRY through merged_registry(), and the daily run picks the tenant up on the next 06:10 cycle. Three names keep their existing first-registered adapter by setdefault (强生 -> Workday, 斯堪尼亚 -> Moka, 药明康德 -> p1_sources_41_50), so their tupu360 rows are enabled but do not take over the registry slot. The full-site evidence (xlsx/csv, 5523 rows) stays on branch feat/tupu360-fullsite under pipeline-watch/tupu360-fullsite/ and is NOT merged here. Verified 2026-09-19, enabled 2026-09-20 (feat/gap-report).
